status.description:
Boleto status:
* `generating` Generating
* `draft` Draft
* `generation_failed` Generation failed
* `opened` Open
* `canceled` Canceled
* `paid` Paid
* `overdue` Overdue
* `validation_failed` Invalid
* `chargeback` Charged back

bank_billet_ids.description: IDs of boletos to be canceled

body.description: At least one parameter is mandatory in the call. Parameters can be combined.
